name: Web Application Dynamic Scanning
description: Dynamic scanning and testing of running web applications using proxy-based and automated scanning tools. Covers Burp Suite Professional operation, OWASP ZAP, authenticated scanning, scan policy tuning, manual request manipulation, and integration of automated and manual testing workflows.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to web application dynamic scanning

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands web proxy tools and dynamic scanning concepts
evidence: Can explain how web proxies intercept and modify HTTP traffic
Familiar with Burp Suite and OWASP ZAP interfaces
Understands the difference between passive and active scanning

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Operates scanning tools under supervision for basic web testing
evidence: Configured Burp Suite proxy and intercepted HTTP/HTTPS traffic
Performed authenticated crawling and scanning of lab applications
Used Repeater and Intruder for manual request manipulation
Scan results reviewed by authorized tester

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently conducts web application dynamic testing using proxy tools
evidence: Independently tested 5+ web applications using Burp Suite Professional
Configures scan policies and authentication for complex applications
Combines automated scanning with manual testing for comprehensive coverage
Passed proficiency assessment on web dynamic scanning

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Develops custom extensions; handles complex scanning scenarios
evidence: Develops custom Burp extensions (BApps) for engagement-specific needs
Handles scanning of WebSocket, SSE, and non-standard web technologies
Configures and tunes scans for large-scale applications with session management
Mentors junior testers on Burp Suite and scanning methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Authority on web dynamic testing tooling; develops methodology
evidence: Published Burp extensions or web testing tools used by the community
Developed the lab's web application dynamic testing methodology
Evaluates and selects scanning tools for the lab
Trains teams on advanced web dynamic testing

assessment_methods.description: Perform a comprehensive dynamic test of a prepared web application using Burp Suite, combining automated and manual techniques
Observe proxy configuration, scan tuning, and manual testing workflow
